documentTitle.description: Official title of the form or statement (e.g., Asset Depreciation Form 4562).

documentDate.description: The filing or preparation date of the document, typically matching the tax year or reporting period.

authorName.description: Name of the preparer, taxpayer, or responsible party who completed the form.

headerFields.description: Key metadata fields identifying the document’s origin and purpose.

assetDescription.description: Clear description of the asset (e.g., 'Office Laptop Dell XPS 15').

dateService.description: The date the asset was first placed in service and became available for business use.

cost.description: Original purchase cost or acquisition price of the asset.

businessPercentage.description: Percentage of total use attributed to business purposes (0–100%).

section179.description: Portion of the cost elected for Section 179 immediate deduction.

bonusDepreciation.description: Additional first-year depreciation (bonus) applied under IRS rules.

basisForDepreciation.description: Adjusted basis of the asset used to calculate depreciation (cost minus reductions like Section 179 or business-use limits).

period.description: Recovery period of the asset (e.g., 3 years, 5 years, 39 years) based on IRS asset classification.

convention.description: Depreciation convention applied (e.g., Mid-Quarter, Mid-Year, or Mid-Month).

method.description: Depreciation method used (e.g., MACRS 200% DB, Straight Line).

priorDepreciation.description: Cumulative depreciation already claimed in previous years.

currentDepreciation.description: Depreciation expense calculated for the current tax year.

assetList.description: Detailed schedule of assets placed in service, including acquisition, usage, and depreciation details for tax reporting.
